newsitem.title: UK: Scott Pickford not ready to consider bid.
newsitem.headline: Scott Pickford not ready to consider bid.

text.p: The board of British geoscience and engineering services group Scott Pickford Plc said on Friday that it could not recommend at this stage the cash offer by Core Laboratories N.V. or the possible cash offer by Aerodata Holdings Ltd.
The company recommended shareholders take no action in respect of their holdings in Scott Pickford shares.
The company did not give any specific reasons for its decision.
Scott Pickford Plc faces two rival bid approaches with the U.S. based Core Laboratories making a 6.7 million stg cash bid.
On Thursday, Core launched its bid at 53 pence per share which was followed by Australia's Aerodata Holdings which said it was also in talks with Scott Pickford about a possible rival 53 pence bid.
Aerodata has already built up a 21.5 percent stake in Scott Pickford.
